source: Original procedural Blender scene built from library.json. OpenAI ImageGen received the reviewed camera as its sole image input.
purpose: Illustrate the fictional owner's accepted reading arrangement in the public worked example.

findings.chair: One exposed oak frame with separate sage linen seat and back beside the south window. The photograph adds upholstery texture and seams.
findings.shelves: Two oiled oak boards meet at the upper-middle central upright of the north bookcase. The other shelves retain their painted finish. The near end of the bookcase continues outside the crop.
findings.window: Both images show two uncovered panes, one vertical mullion, a painted sill and a diffuse sky. The photograph introduces a cloud texture.
findings.door: The camera and photograph face east. The west leaf and its head are behind the camera. The reverse native view and CAD opening study establish their location and head treatment.
findings.other: The lamp stays behind the chair. The framed print, skirting and direction of the floorboards remain recognisable. The photograph refines the book spines and wood grain.

limits: The photograph illustrates the arrangement and finishes. Use the CAD file for dimensions. Shelf fixing, socket position, purchase and construction remain outside the fictional design acceptance.
